title: Tools Template parameters
description: Phase G, Stage 2 (DECISIONS.md DEC-098/DEC-099). The single source of truth for every value substituted into skeleton-tools/ -- the sibling schema to template-schema.json (the Agent Template's own), kept as a separate file rather than a union schema because the two templates render independently and take genuinely different parameter sets. Every '${{ values.x }}' placeholder in skeleton-tools/ corresponds to exactly one property below.

name.title: Project name
name.description: The base identifier for the scaffolded tool server project. Every namespace, resource name, and OTEL service name in the rendered output is derived from this.

owner.title: Owning team
owner.description: Backstage catalog owner reference for the scaffolded project (e.g. 'group:default/team-name').

description.title: Project description
description.description: One-sentence description of this tool server's purpose, used in README.md and catalog-info.yaml.
description.default: An MCP tool server scaffolded from the golden-path-agent blueprint's Tools Template.

allowedConsumerName.title: Allowed consumer project name
allowedConsumerName.description: The 'name' value of the single Agent Template instance authorized to reach this server's own NetworkPolicy-restricted ingress (deploy/kustomize/base/networkpolicy.yaml). Single-consumer only this phase -- see that file's own header comment.

repoOwner.title: Git repository owner/org
repoOwner.description: Same local-render-only note as the Agent Template's own template-schema.json.

repoName.title: Git repository name
repoName.description: Same local-render-only note as the Agent Template's own template-schema.json.
